title: Record envelope
description: The shared provenance envelope every typed record in the EVE Assist interchange format wears (see src/records/README.md, "The interchange-format doctrine"). `data` is intentionally unconstrained here — validate it separately against the per-kind schema named by `type` (e.g. eve-wallet-journal-entry.schema.json for type EveWalletJournalEntry).

id.description: Present once withIdentity() has run: an ni: URI content id (identifyContent, @red-cup-engineering/computer-data-engine).

type.description: PascalCase record kind, e.g. "EveWalletJournalEntry"; names the per-kind schema to validate `data` against.

recordedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds. For source.kind "esi" this is the originating ESI observation's recordedAt, not envelope-construction time.
